title: Eusebius of Caesarea, Chronicon Book 1 (Chronographia; «Хроника» Евсевия, кн. 1)
author: Eusebius of Caesarea
language: Classical Armenian (version of the lost Greek), plus Greek fragments in Synkellos
genre: Chronography: an anthology of national histories and king-lists
edition: Aucher 1818 (Armenian + Latin; public domain). Schoene–Petermann 1875 (public domain). Karst, GCS 20 (1911), German translation
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Хроника Евсевия): only partly in Russian, namely the Roman-era Canons in Jerome's Latin version (Kiev 1910). Book 1 not translated. ancientrome has only the Ptolemy king-list (from English)
en_evidence: Online only, not peer-reviewed: attalus.org translation of Book 1 (Schoene–Petermann pp. 1–295). Jerome's Canons in English on tertullian.org
other_translations: German (Karst 1911, from the Armenian). Latin (Aucher, Petermann)
value: Preserves excerpts of Berossus, Abydenus, Alexander Polyhistor, Manetho, Castor and Porphyry on the Ptolemies and Seleucids. A core source for Near Eastern and Hellenistic chronology, used by Assyriologists, Egyptologists and Hellenistic historians.
ai_feasibility: Medium: LLMs are weaker in Classical Armenian. Mitigate with Greek parallels (Synkellos) and Karst as cross-check; an Armenologist reviewer is required
pilot_unit: The Chaldaean section (Berossus/Abydenus/Polyhistor excerpts), est. 8–10k words
